source.source_title: Career America: The Federal Government Time
source.why_this_clip: A tan brick cordless phone with an antenna and keypad floats against a star field and rotates from a diagonal toward upright while shrinking and drifting. The phone is on screen without a cut from about 21 s to 32.5 s (cuts at 13 s and 35.5 s); this interval has the most rotation, though a phone number caption overlaps the lower part.
